spec: DESIGN.md — installations, the machine seam, standalone save cards (issue #181)
description: PCSX2's save answer where the question names a PS2 disc and the slots hold one folder card: the serial read from the disc's SYSTEM.CNF (atlas/ps2_disc.py), the GameDB's memcardFilters consulted, and the card's directories beginning B, the region letter and that serial stated as the game's save unit, own-folders-by-prefix — or the folder card's tree unchanged where the serial, the card or the prefix is not established.

vectors.name: pcsx2-a-folder-card-names-the-games-own-directories
vectors.rationale: Slot 1 holds a folder card (a directory at Mcd001.ps2, FileMcd_SetType, MemoryCardFile.cpp:584-604 at v2.8.2) whose _pcsx2_superblock is formatted, so PCSX2 indexes it (IsFormatted, MemoryCardFolder.cpp:133-137). The question names Game.iso, whose SYSTEM.CNF says BOOT2 = cdrom0:\SLUS_201.52;1 — the serial SLUS-20152 (ExecutablePathToSerial, CDVD.cpp:525-575). PCSX2 shows the game the card's directories whose names contain SLUS-20152 (FilterMatches, MemoryCardFolder.cpp:424-446): BASLUS-20152AC04 and BASLUS-20152SYS, both beginning BA and the serial, so the prefix is BASLUS-20152, read off the card. BESLES-50000GAME is another game's, BADATA-SYSTEM the console's shared folder, _pcsx2_deleted_BASLUS-20152OLD the card's own record of a deleted save (its _pcsx2_ names are never listed, :1785, :1391), and BASLUS-20152.txt no directory. The folder card's group carries own-folders-by-prefix, the file card in slot 2 stays the shared image it is, and ps2-save-prefix-may-differ says the game, not PCSX2, picked the prefix.

vectors.name: pcsx2-a-game-that-never-saved-is-a-unit-of-no-directories
vectors.rationale: The card is indexed and holds no directory whose name contains SLUS-20152, so the game has not saved here yet. The unit is stated all the same, with no members: the prefix is BASLUS-20152, its region letter taken from the serial's family (SLUS, America) because the card shows none, and the ps2-save-prefix-may-differ caveat says so. Once the game saves, the next answer reads the letter off the card.

vectors.name: pcsx2-a-second-disc-saves-under-the-serial-its-gamedb-entry-names
vectors.rationale: SLES-82012 is the second disc of a two-disc release, and PCSX2's GameDB lists memcardFilters [SLES-82011] for it (bin/resources/GameIndex.yaml at fd9d310c), which replace the serial as the folder card's filter (VMManager.cpp:1113, :1161): the game sees the first disc's directories, so the prefix is BESLES-82011 and BESLES-82011DATA is the member.
